What can Japan's first chair actually change?――世界銀行・IMF開発委員会の権限と限界

Japan's finance minister Satsuki Katayama was nominated on October 13, 2026, as the next chair of the World Bank–IMF Development Committee. 正式選任は15日の予定。The chair does not approve individual loans or control development budgets. This essay looks at the committee's 1974 origins, its 25-member structure, agenda-setting powers, contemporary issues, and the conditions for potential Japanese business benefits.
